hooks.name: EU AI compliance — tool
hooks.description: Checks every write and shell tool call against the EU AI compliance policy service (POST /v1/check) before it runs. A Kiro command hook blocks via its exit code: BLOCK and ASK exit non-zero (2) with the reason on stderr so the tool call is blocked; WARN exits 0 and prints its obligations to stdout (added to context); ALLOW is silent. The matcher targets built-in write and shell tools plus all MCP tools. Requires guardrails-hook on PATH and the service reachable at GUARDRAILS_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8080). Copy to .kiro/hooks/ in the project (or ~/.kiro/hooks/ for every workspace).
